cancellation_rebooking.text: If a flight is cancelled by the airline, the customer gets free rebooking on the next available flight within 24 hours OR a full refund — customer's choice.
cancellation_rebooking.refund_processing: Full refunds are processed within 7 business days to the original payment method only.

delay_compensation.text: Under 3 hours: ₹500 meal voucher. More than 3 hours: meal voucher + lounge access. More than 5 hours: meal voucher + hotel accommodation, covering ONLY the delayed hours, NOT a full night's stay.

fare_difference.text: For voluntary rebooking on a higher-fare flight, the customer pays the fare difference. Agents cannot waive more than ₹1,500 without supervisor approval.

loyalty_tier.text: Gold and Platinum customers get priority rebooking (first access to next-available seats) but NO additional compensation beyond standard policy.

refund_processing.text: Full refunds for airline-caused cancellations are processed within 7 business days and issued to the original payment method only.

allowed_actions: Rebook on next available flight within 24h at no charge (airline-caused)
Issue meal vouchers and lounge access per delay rule
Arrange hotel accommodation for delayed-hours portion where it qualifies
Initiate refund request for airline-caused cancellations
Provide customer's own booking and flight status information
prohibited_actions: Approving any compensation beyond the stated policy amounts
Handling threats of legal action or formal complaints — escalate immediately
Processing refunds to a different payment method than original
